description: The Magnavox Odyssey, the very first video game console.  Released in 1972, the Odyssey was a simple and crude device that generated shapes on the television that could be controlled and interacted with.  It only produced black and white graphics and had no sound, but was limited to only using discrete components like diodes and transistors.  It was replaced in 1975 with the Magnavox Odyssey series, a line of dedicated Pong consoles.
